entities.name: NAD(P)H-hydrate repair enzyme
observations: 510-aa query has 36.8% identity and 93.1% query coverage to reviewed Thermotoga maritima Nnr (Q9X024), E=1.45e-87; annotation is homology-based, not direct experimental evidence for query.
Likely bifunctional NAD(P)HX epimerase (EC 5.1.99.6) and ADP-dependent NAD(P)HX dehydratase (EC 4.2.1.136), involved in metabolite repair and nicotinamide nucleotide metabolism.
Pfam domains: YjeF_N (residues 26–184) and Carb_kinase (239–480); matching architecture supports Nnr-like function.
Reference annotation reports K+ cofactor; applicability to query inferred from homolog.
